description: This Java source file defines a Spring service class 'LoanApplicationModificationCommandHandler' that handles commands for modifying loan applications within a financial software system. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses 'LoanApplicationWritePlatformService' to perform the update operation.

classes.name: LoanApplicationModificationCommandHandler
